SECTION ONE
Purpose, Scope, Basis, and Definitions
Purpose
ARTICLE 1 – (1) The purpose of this Directive is to regulate the duties, authorities, and responsibilities
of the International Relations Coordination Office established under the Rectorate of Gebze Technical
University, the operation of its governing bodies, and the procedures and principles related to its
activities.
Scope
ARTICLE 2 – (1) This Directive covers the working procedures and principles of the International
Relations Coordination Office of Gebze Technical University.
Basis
ARTICLE 3 – (1) This Directive has been prepared based on the subparagraph (c) of Article 4 of the
Higher Education Law No. 2547.
Definitions
ARTICLE 4 – (1) In this Directive, the following terms have the following definitions:
a) Department al Coordinator: The person assigned by a Head of Department /Institute Director to
manage activities within the department or program under the Erasmus/M evlana/Farabi Exchange
Programs
b) Institutional Erasmus Coordinator: Assistant Coordinator of the International Exchange Programs
Office appointed by the Rector
c) Institution al Farabi Coordinator: Assistant Coordinator of the International Exchange Programs
Office appointed by the Rector
d) Coordination Office: International Relations Coordination Office of Gebze Technical University
e) Coordinator: International Relations Coordinator of Gebze Technical University
f) Assistant Coordinator: The supervising staff in the offices of the International Relations Coordination
Office of Gebze Technical University
g) Institutional Mevlana Coordinator: Assistant Coordinator of the International Exchange Programs
Office appointed by the Rector
h) Rector: Rector of Gebze Technical University
i) Vice-Rector: Vice-Rector responsible for the International Relations Coordinat ion Office of Gebze
Technical University
j) Senate: Senate of Gebze Technical University
k) International Exchange Programs Office: The unit responsible for managing
Erasmus/Mevlana/Farabi Exchange Programs at Gebze Technical University
l) International Cooperation Office: The unit that handles bilateral agreements and protocols, incoming
international student and staff processes in collaboration with relevant departments/divisions at Gebze
Technical University

SECTION TWO
Objective, Areas of Activitiy, and Suboffices of the International Relations Coordination Office
Objective of the Coordination Office
ARTICLE 5 – (1) The objective of the Coordination Office is to provide the services needed by the
university in international projects, carry out exchange, promotion, and co llaboration activities under
programs such as Erasmus/Farabi/Mevlana, improve these activities, follow up the university's
international bilateral agreements and protocols, manage the processes of incoming international students
and staff, and support increasing the university's international recognition.
Coordinator
ARTICLE 6 – (1) The Coordinator is assigned by the Rector from among the academic staff of Gebze
Technical University for a period of three years. The coordinator may be reassigned after the term of duty
ends.
Duties of the Coordinator
ARTICLE 7 – (1) The duties of the International Relations Coordinator are as follows:
a) To carry out work towards achieving the goals and objectives stated in the university's strategic plan ,
action plan, and work program
b) To prepare job descriptions for staff, distribute tasks among offices, and ensure performance audits
c) To prepare and implement any kind of promotional and informative programs to be conducted by the
Coordination Office
d) To prepare the annual activity reports of the Coordination Office and communicate them to the relevant
divisions
e) To perform other duties assigned by the Rector
Areas of Activity of the Coordination Office
ARTICLE 8 – (1) The areas of activity of the International Relations Coordination Office are as
follows:
a) To communicate the university’s international project calls and announcements to students and staff,
organize informative meetings, and provide support in project preparation and implementation
b) To contribute to the execution of international projects in which the u niversity is a lead or partner,
ensuring coordination with the relevant divisions

c) To provide guidance and coordination services to ensure effective participation of university faculty in
exchange and grant programs related to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Presidency of the European
Union-Turkish National Agency, and the Council of Higher Education (YÖK)
d) To engage in bilateral and multilateral co llaboration with universities, research centers, and similar
institutions abroad to facilitate exchange for academic staff, students, and administrative staff
e) To encourage the academic divisions to prepare necessary catalog and course schedule materials for
incoming students and staff under European Union programs and projects to be able to take courses/teach
courses
f) To assist with the needs of incoming academic staff, students, and administrative staff within the bounds
of possibility and support them with orientation programs, language courses, and other planned activities,
and offer solutions in case of problems
g) To provide assistance for academic staff, students, and administrative staff visiting universities and
research and education institutions abroad
h) To promote international projects, internship programs, and events to academic /administrative staff
and students, provide the necessary training for them to be able to take part in these projects , and offer
information, guidance and other supportive activities
i) To plan and implement activities to improve the international recognition of the university, contributing
to the preparation of promotional materials such as catalogs and so on
j) To ensure coordination among the relevant divisions of the university during the admission and
enrollment processes for international students and staff
k) To organize programs that support the adaptation of international students to the universit y and the
environment
l) To ensure the representation of the university in national/international educational events, fairs,
conferences, and seminars relevant to its area of activity
Suboffices of the Coordination Office
ARTICLE 9 – (1) The suboffices of the International Relations Coordination Office are as follows:
a) International Projects Office
b) International Exchange Programs Office
c) International Cooperation Office
International Projects Office
ARTICLE 10 – (1) The International Projects Office conducts its activities under the Assistant
Coordinator’s supervision and has the following duties:
a) To increase the number and quality of international projects
b) To follow up on project and collaboration opportunities with international organizations offering grants
and support
c) To provide support for researchers involved in international projects

d) To coordinate informative, promotional, awareness, and training activities about international projects
e) To act as the university’s contact point for European Commission grants and funds, ensuring
announcements are made within the university in cooperation with the National Contact Point
f) To assist the university and its researchers in using European Commission grants and funds in the most
effective way
g) To maintain coordination and communication with relevant national institutions and organizations and
stakeholder institutions responsible for the national management of international funds
h) To ensure coordination and communication with the other divisions at university that use the various
tools of the European Commission and other international organizations’ grants and funds
i) To conduct informative activities to help understand better the project calls under the EU programs and
to introduce EU grants and funds, as well as to provide services during the project proposal phase,
including document checks and data transfer into relevant databases
j) To support researchers in project preparation, implementation, and closure processes
k) To review international project applications, documents, and agreement drafts without assessing them
scientifically
l) To provide standard documents and guides, assist in team formation in multi-partner projects, and help
organize meetings among project partners
m) To organize training and promotional activities to encourage university researchers to apply for
European Union projects
n) To publish activity reports related to the events held
International Exchange Programs Office
ARTICLE 11 – (1) The International Exc hange Programs Office conducts its activities under the
Assistant Coordinator’s supervision and has the following duties:
a) To ensure communication and coordination between the university and the National Agency for the
implementation of the Erasmus+ Program
b) To ensure communication and coordination between the university and the Council of Higher
Education (YÖK) for the implementation of Mevlana and Farabi Programs
c) To make institutional agreements for the Erasmus+ P rogram in coordination with the Departmental
Erasmus Coordinator and track their updates
d) To make institutional agreements for the Mevlana P rogram with the Departmental Mevlana
Coordinator and track their updates
e) To make institutional agreements for the Farabi Program with the Departmental Farabi Coordinator
and track their updates
f) To collaborate with the higher education institutions under the Erasmus+ Program within the framework
of the "Erasmus Student and Staff Exchange Regulation," ensuring the academic recognition of the
trainings, internships, and studies completed by the students and staff participating in the program
activities and conduct other works and procedures related to the Erasmus+ Program
g) To collaborate with higher education institutions within the framework of the Mevlana Program,
ensuring the academic recognition of the trainings, internships, and studies completed by the students and
staff participating in the program activities and conduct other works and procedures related to the Mevlana
Program

h) To collaborate with higher education institutions within the framework of the Farabi Program, ensuring
the academic recognition of the trainings, internships, and studies completed by the students and staff
participating in the program activities and conduct other works and pr ocedures related to the Erasmus+
Program
i) To carry out the institutional coordination duties for the Erasmus, Mevlana, and Farabi P rograms and
conduct the activities related to the expenditures to be made under these programs
International Cooperation Office
ARTICLE 12 – (1) The International Cooperation Office conducts its activities under the Assistant
Coordinator’s supervision and has the following duties:
a) To promote the university to prospective international students, inform them about applicati on
processes, admission, and enrollment, and facilitate their communication with the relevant divisions
b) To promote the university to visiting researchers from abroad within the framework of the "Regulation
on Visiting and Postdoctoral Researchers," providing them with information about application processes
and facilitating their communication with the relevant divisions
c) To ensure communication with the university’s internal and external stakeholders for international
collaborations and manage all required processes
d) To provide guidance services for international students and staff facing issues at the university
e) To organize programs that support the adaptation of international students to the university and the
environment
f) To ensure the university's representation at required national/international events such as trainings ,
fairs, conferences, and seminars organized towards prospective international students
g) To announce international scholarships to students
h) To promote the university to international delegations, coordinate their collaboration requests
i) To review, prepare drafts, conduct and manage the sig nature process for bilateral and multilateral
agreements/ protocols/goodwill agreements to be made with higher education institutions including the
institutions abroad
j) To follow up the exchange process of students and staff under the said agreements/protocols
k) To prepare international promotional materials like catalogs, brochures, and so on and create content
for the International Relations Coordination Office’s social media accounts
l) To monitor the participation, preparation and post -participation p rocesses of the university in
international fairs aimed at establishing collaborations between the university and univer sities or
organizations abroad
m) To carry out the membership procedures for the university's participation in international
organizations, keep their records, and manage pre- and post-process activities
n) To support the activities related to the decisions made by the International Student Admission s
Commission and the Foreign National Academic Staff Evaluation Commission during their meetings
SECTION THREE
Cases Without Provision, Entry Into Force, and Execution
Cases Without Provision
ARTICLE 13 – (1) For cases not covered in this Directive, the relevant legistation’s provisions shall
apply.
